tasks.task: Set Up Godot Project Skeleton And Toolchain
tasks.description: Install Godot 4.5 stable for Linux and create the project skeleton with git repository and headless test runner.

steps.description: Write install script that downloads the latest Godot stable Linux binary
Create project.godot with application name, features, Forward Plus renderer
Create directory layout for src, scenes, tests, scripts
Initialize git repository on main branch with Godot .gitignore
Add headless smoke test runner script verifying zero exit code

tasks.acceptance-criteria: Godot binary must respond to --version with 4.5 or higher. Project must import cleanly via godot --headless --import. Smoke test runner must execute headless and exit 0. Git repository must exist on main branch with .godot directory ignored.

unit: Godot --version output matches 4.5 or higher
Headless smoke test script prints SMOKE_OK and exits with code 0
godot --headless --import completes without error output for the new project

tasks.description: Create the pure-logic BallSim module with fixed-step integration, bounce response, net collision, and landing classification.

steps.description: Define tennis court dimension constants plus ball physical parameters
Implement fixed-step integrator with gravity plus optional air drag
Implement ground bounce with restitution plus horizontal friction
Implement net plane collision with event reporting
Add landing point plus court classification API

tasks.acceptance-criteria: BallSim must produce identical state sequences for repeated identical inputs. No-drag trajectories must match closed-form projectile solutions within 1 cm at 20 m range. Ten second simulations must contain no NaN. Bounce vertical velocity must scale with configured restitution. Net collision event must fire when the trajectory crosses the net plane below net height.

unit: Same initial conditions produce bit-identical trajectories across repeated runs
No-drag trajectory lands within 1 cm of the closed-form projectile solution at 20 m range
Ten second simulation contains no NaN or Infinity in position or velocity
Bounce output vertical velocity equals incoming velocity times configured restitution
Horizontal velocity after bounce equals incoming value times configured friction factor
Net collision event triggers when crossing the net plane below 0.914 m center height
Landing classification marks points beyond singles sideline or baseline as out
Zero velocity input terminates simulation without errors

tasks.description: Create a solver that computes initial ball velocity reaching a target landing point while clearing the net, built on BallSim.

steps.description: Implement ballistic initial guess from target range plus apex height
Add iterative refinement scoring net clearance, landing error
Enforce speed caps while rejecting unreachable targets with error codes

tasks.acceptance-criteria: Solved trajectories must land within 5 cm of requested targets when resimulated by BallSim. All solved trajectories must clear the net with configurable minimum margin. Solver must reject impossible targets with explicit error codes. Convergence must complete within 100 iterations across a 12 by 8 grid of targets and speed tiers.

unit: Solver returns a solution within 5 cm of target for a 12x8 grid of court targets and speed tiers
Every solved trajectory shows net clearance greater than the configured minimum margin
Solver rejects targets behind the net with the defined unreachable error code
Solver converges within 100 iterations for all valid grid cases
Identical inputs produce identical solutions on repeated calls
integration: Solutions resimulated through the real BallSim from Task 2 land within tolerance and clear the net

tasks.task: Implement Joy-Con Sensor Driver And Attitude Filter
tasks.description: Read Joy-Con motion through the kernel evdev IMU interface with L and R device matching, static calibration, and complementary attitude filtering.

steps.description: Enumerate input devices, matching the configured Joy-Con side by name plus product id
Implement an evdev reader decoding accel, gyro samples at 200 Hz
Add static calibration capturing gyro bias plus neutral pose
Implement complementary filter fusing gyro with gravity reference
Add left plus right handed mirror mapping of sensor axes

tasks.acceptance-criteria: Driver must discover the evdev IMU device matching the configured handedness when a Joy-Con is connected. Filter output must converge to known orientations of synthetic streams within 2 degrees in 2 seconds. Calibrated static streams must drift below 1 degree per minute. Handedness mirror option must flip the configured sensor axis signs. Malformed evdev bytes must hold the last good sample without NaN.

unit: Synthetic static gyro stream with known bias yields drift under 1 degree per minute after calibration
Synthetic stream with known orientation converges within 2 degrees after 2 seconds
Left and right handed mirror mappings flip the expected axis signs on synthetic data
Missing or malformed IIO readings hold the last good sample without NaN
Pose and swing velocity outputs stay continuous during simulated sample dropouts

tasks.description: Provide deterministic parameterized synthetic swings and replay streams through the shared input interface for automated headless tests only, with no mouse or keyboard play mode.

steps.description: Define the shared input provider interface for pose, velocity streams
Add a recorded swing library with parameterized forehand, backhand, serve variants
Guarantee replay determinism for recorded swing streams
Wire the provider behind a test-only flag so shipping builds require Joy-Con motion input

tasks.acceptance-criteria: The provider must satisfy the same interface contract as the Joy-Con driver. Replaying a recorded swing must produce identical pose and velocity streams. Parameterized mock swings must reproduce the requested peak speed within 5 percent. No mouse or keyboard play path may exist in shipping builds.

unit: Replay of the same recorded swing produces identical pose and velocity streams
Parameterized mock swing peak speed matches the requested value within 5 percent
Every swing variant yields finite pose and velocity samples through the real driver pipeline
integration: Mock provider and the Joy-Con driver from Task 4 pass a shared interface contract test suite

tasks.task: Build Court Scene And Ball Visualization
tasks.description: Create the programmatic 3D court, net, lighting, ball mesh with trail, and landing markers driven by simulation state.

steps.description: Build court surface with boundary, service line meshes from dimension constants
Build net mesh with 0.914 m center plus 1.07 m post heights
Add lighting, sky, first person baseline camera rig
Add ball mesh with motion trail plus bounce effect
Add landing markers colored by simulation classification

tasks.acceptance-criteria: Court line meshes must match official singles dimension constants within 1 mm. Net mesh must span 0.914 m center height and 1.07 m post height. Ball node position must follow BallSim state within 2 cm every frame. Landing markers must display the in or out color matching the simulation classification.

unit: Court line vertex positions match dimension constants within 1 mm
Net mesh geometry matches 0.914 m center and 1.07 m post heights
Marker color mapping matches the expected in or out color for known boundary coordinates
integration: Ball node driven by the real BallSim from Task 2 stays within 2 cm of simulation state across a full simulated rally

tasks.task: Implement First Person Racket And Hit Resolution
tasks.description: Attach the racket to the first person view with handedness anchors and resolve swing hits into outgoing ball velocities.

steps.description: Model the racket mesh from primitives with strings plus grip
Anchor racket pose per handedness from the input provider interface
Implement swing velocity tracking with hit detection shell sweep
Implement outgoing velocity blending face orientation with aim assist
Add hit cooldown plus sweet spot speed scaling

tasks.acceptance-criteria: Swings above the speed threshold must hit balls entering the racket shell while slower swings must not. Outgoing ball speed must increase monotonically with swing speed. Aim assist must keep outgoing shots inside the opponent court across the defined face orientation range. Hit cooldown must prevent double hits on the same swing. Handedness option must mirror the racket anchor side.

unit: Mock fast swing from the recorded library triggers a hit when the mock ball enters the racket shell
Mock swing below the speed threshold produces no hit
Outgoing speed rises monotonically with the mock swing speed parameter
Aim assist blend keeps outgoing direction inside the court cone across a face orientation sweep
A second hit inside the cooldown window is rejected
Handedness toggle mirrors the racket anchor transform
integration: Hits resolved with recorded mock swings from Task 5 produce BallSim trajectories from Task 2 that land in bounds deterministically

tasks.description: Add the serve sequence with ball toss, timing window, and fault handling using configurable auto or manual toss.

steps.description: Implement the serve state machine with ready, toss, struck states
Implement automatic toss with fixed apex timing
Implement manual toss on button press with timing window
Route serve hits through hit resolution with serve speed caps
Report serve faults plus replay per configured rule

tasks.acceptance-criteria: Auto toss must release the ball to a repeatable apex position each serve. Manual toss must grant a hit window matching configured bounds. Serve speed caps must clamp outgoing serve velocity. A serve landing out must trigger replay without score change under the default no double fault rule.

unit: Auto toss produces identical toss trajectory parameters across serves
Manual toss hit window opens and closes at the configured times
Serve speed cap clamps outgoing serve velocity to the configured maximum
Fault serve triggers a replay event without score change in default mode
integration: Serve hits flow through the hit resolution pipeline from Task 7 and BallSim from Task 2 with valid trajectories

tasks.description: Create the opponent that predicts incoming shots with BallSim, teleports to intercept valid shots, and returns to random in-bounds targets.

steps.description: Implement shot prediction returning net clearance, landing point
Implement intercept decision honoring configured error, reaction parameters
Implement instant teleport to an intercept position behind the predicted landing point
Implement timed scripted swing contacting the ball at the interception time
Implement return sampling with solver-computed random in-bounds targets

tasks.acceptance-criteria: With error rate zero the AI must intercept every valid incoming shot and let net or out shots pass. Teleport must occur at hit time with no travel phase. Returns must land inside the player singles court with margin for all seeded samples and must clear the net. Prediction must match the real BallSim outcome exactly. Error rate above zero must produce misses at the configured rate.

unit: Prediction landing point equals direct BallSim evaluation landing point exactly
Error rate zero yields intercept decision true for all in-bounds shot samples
Intercept decision is false for shots predicted to hit the net or land out
Seeded return sampling always yields targets inside the player court with margin
All seeded sampled returns clear the net through the solver from Task 3
Error rate 0.3 produces misses in 25 to 35 percent of 1000 seeded trials
integration: A scripted 100-shot rally through the real BallSim from Task 2 and the solver from Task 3 sustains indefinitely at error rate zero

tasks.task: Implement Tennis Rules And Scoring Engine
tasks.description: Create an event-driven referee handling bounce and fault calls, tennis scoring with sudden death, and server rotation.

steps.description: Define point outcome events from bounce, landing, net events
Implement first bounce in, out calls on the opponent court
Implement double bounce plus net fault point awards
Implement 15 30 40 scoring with sudden death at 40 40
Implement server rotation per game plus match end detection

tasks.acceptance-criteria: Scoring must progress 0 15 30 40 game for consecutive points won. At 40 40 the next point must win the game. First bounce out must award the point to the hitter's opponent. Double bounce must award the point to the last hitter. Net fault must award the point to the receiving side. Server must alternate each game and match end must trigger at the configured games won count.

unit: Score advances 0 15 30 40 game across consecutive point wins
A point at 40 40 wins the game immediately
First bounce out awards the point to the opponent of the hitter
Double bounce awards the point to the last hitter
Net fault awards the point to the receiving side
Server rotation flips after each completed game
Match end event fires when the configured games threshold is reached
integration: The referee derives valid outcomes from scripted rally events produced by BallSim from Task 2, the hit pipeline from Task 7, and the opponent AI from Task 9

tasks.description: Create the main menu, persisted options covering handedness and difficulty, and an in-game HUD fed by live game state.

steps.description: Build the main menu with start, options, quit actions
Build the options panel for handedness, calibration, sensitivity, assist, AI difficulty, serve mode
Persist options to a user settings file with clamped ranges
Build the HUD showing score, server, rally count, swing speed
Wire option changes into the live game configuration singletons

tasks.acceptance-criteria: Menu must navigate between states without dead ends. Every option must persist across application restarts with clamped valid ranges. Changing handedness must switch the live input device mapping. Changing the AI error rate must change AI behavior. HUD score must match the scoring engine output during matches.

unit: Settings round trip saves and loads all fields with clamped ranges
Menu state machine transitions cover every button without dead ends
HUD score text renders mock scoring engine snapshots as expected
integration: The handedness option drives device selection in the Joy-Con driver from Task 4
The AI difficulty option maps to the error parameter in the opponent AI from Task 9
The HUD displays live output of the scoring engine from Task 10 during automated scripted matches

tasks.task: Add Audio Haptics And Game Feel Polish
tasks.description: Add hit, whoosh, bounce sounds, swing trail, teleport effects, camera feedback, and Joy-Con rumble on contact.

steps.description: Add procedural hit, whoosh, bounce, net sounds
Add racket swing trail rendering
Add teleport flash plus particles for the opponent
Add camera micro shake on hits
Add rumble output through joypad force feedback

tasks.acceptance-criteria: Each gameplay event must trigger its audio within one frame. The swing trail must render continuously during swings without artifacts in synthetic tests. Rumble requests must carry valid device, duration, amplitude parameters. The teleport effect must play exactly once per AI jump.

unit: The audio event table maps every gameplay event to a loadable non-empty stream
The trail point buffer appends mock pose samples in order and caps length
Rumble commands carry device index, duration, amplitude within valid ranges
integration: Hit events from the Task 7 pipeline dispatch audio plus rumble within the same frame in scripted mock matches

tasks.task: Integrate Hardware Playtest And Document Game
tasks.description: Verify the full game with real Joy-Con on both hands, tune feel parameters, capture acceptance screenshots, and write the README.

steps.description: Write the Joy-Con bluetooth pairing plus permissions guide
Run an automated scripted match soak from menu to match end
Tune hit forgiveness, aim assist, AI presentation parameters
Capture acceptance screenshots of court, HUD, teleport effects
Write the README with build, run, controls, connection instructions

tasks.acceptance-criteria: The automated scripted match must complete from menu through match end without errors. The game must sustain 60 fps at 1080p on the workstation. README instructions must reproduce a working launch on this machine. Acceptance screenshots must exist showing the court, HUD, teleport effects.

unit: The screenshot capture script produces non-empty PNG files for all required scenes
Every script path referenced by the README exists in the repository
integration: The automated soak plays a full scripted match through the menu, options, scoring engine from Task 10, and opponent AI from Task 9 without errors
e2e-manual: User serves and rallies with the left hand Joy-Con L and confirms tracking feels accurate
User switches to right hand mode and confirms mirrored control works
User confirms serve timing feels fair in auto toss mode
User confirms the opponent teleports visibly and returns valid shots
User confirms the driver streams motion from a real connected Joy-Con
